classes.name: Stakeholder
classes.definition: A party that takes part in the CDM process and originates or receives flight or timing information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the stakeholder.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role played in the CDM process.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The Aircraft Operator (AO), who submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides TOBT, ready status, and other flight information.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The Ground Handler (GH), who together with the Aircraft Operator provides TOBT, ready status, and manages the turn-round process.

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: ATC, including Area Control Centre, Approach Control, and Tower units, which issues TSAT, ASAT, and detects milestones via radar.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: Network Operations, which issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and receives DPI messages.

classes.name: Pilot
classes.definition: The flight crew who request start-up and coordinate with the Ground Handler around TSAT.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by registration and type, which may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An arriving or departing flight tracked through the CDM process from ATC Flight Plan activation to take-off.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is an arrival or a departure within its turn-round.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: Current operational status, changed at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, FIR, FINAL, LANDED, IN-BLOCK, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED/TAKE OFF).

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; appropriate fields are marked REGULATED at EOBT-2hr.

operations.name: isReadyWithinTolerance
operations.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT (Milestone 1 effect).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The turn-round of an aircraft, normally comprising a related arriving flight and departing flight.

attributes.name: turnRoundPeriod
attributes.description: The defined or estimated turn-round period used as a basis for calculating TOBT for the departing flight.

classes.name: ATCFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS to all involved ATC units.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: The departure aerodrome named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled off-block time, fed to Network Operations with aircraft registration and first destination data before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, used together with ATOT to calculate ELDT.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

classes.name: RepetitiveFlightPlan
classes.definition: A repetitive flight plan (RFPL), a flight plan covering daily or weekly flights, submitted in some cases instead of a one-off flight plan.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Whether the RFPL covers daily or weekly flights.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to a flight, against which the ATC Flight Plan and airport flight data must be consistent.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The scheduled time associated with the airport slot programme.

attributes.name: coordinated
attributes.description: Whether the airport is coordinated, which determines whether the outbound flight is already known or must be initiated from the flight plan.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A named time quantity (prefixed Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, or Calculated, for an event such as Off-Block, In-Block, Landing, or Take-Off) that describes a flight's progress, with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance; every successive value is kept, an update appends rather than overwrites.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Which named time quantity this is (e.g. TOBT, EOBT, AOBT).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value, or duration for quantities such as EXOT, EXIT, MTTT.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who or what provided this value, e.g. ATC, AO/GH, ACARS, radar system.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Stated accuracy, e.g. +/- 1 minute for ATOT, ALDT, AIBT, ACGT, ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: Locally agreed tolerance applied before partners are informed of a change, e.g. the TTOT tolerance or 5-minute TTOT tolerance at outstation take-off.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: Time at which this value was recorded, so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is manually input it overrides EIBT+MTTT, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: ELDT is calculated using ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: EIBT is computed using ELDT (or ALDT) and the estimated/actual taxi-in time (EXIT).

operations.name: exceedsTolerance
operations.description: Checks whether a new value changes by more than the agreed tolerance, triggering notification of Network Operations or Airport CDM Partners.

classes.name: MilestoneEvent
classes.definition: One of the sixteen defined events in the CDM process, each with its own trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: Number of the milestone (1-16).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the milestone.

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The document's definition of the milestone.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone's procedure.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: The timing rule stated for this milestone.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: The effect the milestone has on flight data and downstream decisions.

attributes.name: operationalStatusChange
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot, and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: sendEDPI
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data; the E-DPI should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2HourMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr most flights are known and all regulated flights receive a CTOT from Network Operations.

operations.name: checkEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: sendFirstTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations at EOBT-2hrs through the first T-DPI message of the updated take-off time estimate.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is provided to Network Operations and the Aircraft Operator.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing times after take off from outstation are consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about updated take off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message, respecting a 5-minute TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdateMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, detected by radar via the assigned SSR code.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproachMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, usually 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: LandedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down on a runway.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks; ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStartedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 8: the commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT), specific to first flights of the day or long-parked aircraft.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalTOBTConfirmationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provides its most accurate TOBT, taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: Performed at a predefined local time to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed tolerance.

classes.name: TSATIssuedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time (TSAT), t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights; no check is performed for this step.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, the TOBT input is processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStartsMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is opened for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain time before TOBT (local variable, e.g. by aircraft type) checks the boarding status and informs the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReadyMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 12: the time all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi (ARDT).

operations.name: informReady
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) or Ready Status (RDY), confirming the flight follows the indicated TOBT.

operations.name: alertIfNoReadyStatus
operations.description: At TOBT plus tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and no ready status message has been received yet.

classes.name: StartUpRequestedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time start-up is requested by the pilot to ATC (ASRT).

operations.name: informASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT) when it occurs.

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequested
operations.description: If no start-up request is made by TSAT plus the locally agreed tolerance window, informs the AO/GH that no start-up has been requested and that TOBT should be updated.

classes.name: StartUpApprovedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start-up approval from ATC.

operations.name: informASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Approval Time (ASAT) when it occurs, indicating start-up/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start-up approval is not granted at TSAT plus tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time an aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) when it occurs; AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or at a defined time prior to TTOT in the case of remote holding.

operations.name: checkTTOTAfterAOBT
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informActualTakeOff
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: Generates an airborne message and removes the flight from the departure sequence; FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform, initiated for each flight, which processes available information and performs the CDM operation actions (ACISP) recorded at each milestone.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status held by the platform for the flight, e.g. INITIATED.

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: Initiates the Airport CDM Platform for the flight and processes all available information (Milestone 1).

operations.name: updateArrivalAndDepartureEstimates
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival, EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure (Milestone 1 ACISP).

operations.name: markRegulated
operations.description: Updates ETOT/TTOT/CTOT and marks appropriate fields as REGULATED (Milestone 2 ACISP).

operations.name: updateTimingsAfterOutstationTakeOff
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated after take off from outstation (Milestone 3 ACISP).

operations.name: updateTimingsAfterRadarOrApproach
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated at Local Radar Update and Final Approach (Milestones 4 and 5 ACISP).

operations.name: changeELDTToALDT
operations.description: ELDT changes to ALDT and EIBT, TOBT, TTOT updated on landing (Milestone 6 ACISP).

operations.name: changeEIBTToAIBT
operations.description: EIBT changes to AIBT and TOBT, TTOT updated on in-block (Milestone 7 ACISP).

operations.name: updateAfterGroundHandlingStart
operations.description: ETTT/TOBT and TTOT updated when ground handling starts (Milestone 8 ACISP).

operations.name: updateTTOTAfterTSAT
operations.description: TTOT updated after TSAT is issued (Milestone 10 ACISP).

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: Records AOBT on off-block (Milestone 15 ACISP).

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: Records ATOT on take off (Milestone 16 ACISP).

operations.name: commenceDPIProcess
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations, if implemented (Milestone 1).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC ground system (e.g. A-SMGCS, Tower FDPS) that detects milestones and calculates taxi time estimates.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy of the ATC system, which the accuracy of radar-detected milestones must equal.

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system associated with an airport that detects a flight based on its assigned SSR code.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or passes/leaves a predetermined level.

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The ACARS aircraft reporting system that can provide actual times such as ATOT, ALDT, AIBT, and AOBT for equipped aircraft.

operations.name: reportActualTime
operations.description: Reports an actual time (ACARS=ON for landing, IN for in-block, OUT for off-block, OFF for take-off).

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system used by Network Operations to monitor the progress of a flight within 3 hours flying time of the destination airport.

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight and provides the basis for sending Flight Update Messages (FUM).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message exchanged with Network Operations at defined points in the process.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message: E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

attributes.name: sentTo
attributes.description: Recipient of the message, normally Network Operations.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time the message was sent.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message (FUM) sent by Network Operations that provides updates of the flight's progress and is used to update ELDT.

attributes.name: updatedELDT
attributes.description: The updated estimated landing time carried by the message.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: A movement (MVT) message sent on actual take off, along with an FSA message and an airborne message.

attributes.name: actualTakeOffTime
attributes.description: The ATOT carried by the message.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

unmodelled: Milestone 4: the objective to decrease the number of stand and gate changes in the last 30 minutes requires high accuracy regarding departure and arrival times, and any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30' (a general operational objective with no owning class beyond the accuracy already recorded on ELDT).

Milestone 4: decisions such as the turn-round period and connecting passengers are taken and need to be stable at this event (a qualitative planning consequence rather than a discrete rule or attribute).

Milestone 9: emphasis is put on the need for the Aircraft Operator to integrate his own strategy to compute a TOBT related to the flight (a stated intent rather than a rule with a computable procedure).
